title: The Empty-Market Step Credited where a Micro Market has been Reopened Repeatedly
content:
Repeated reopenings of an Unattended Micro Market Program market over the trailing year bring a further share of the settlement into the credit, and how often the market format is restocked settles how large that share is.

## The clause

1. Where the agreement carries at or above 2 approved resumption requests over the twelve months to the day the credit is worked out, and the market format is restocked at or above 3 times each week, the frequent empty step of 2 per cent of the settlement is credited as well.
2. Where the agreement carries at or above 2 approved resumption requests over those twelve months, and the market format is restocked below 3 times each week, the sparse empty step of 4 per cent of the settlement is credited as well.
3. Where the agreement carries fewer than 2 approved resumption requests over those twelve months, no empty-market step is credited.

## The boundaries

The empty-market count is 2 approved resumption requests over the twelve months to the day the credit is worked out: exactly 2 meets it, 1 does not. The frequent restock visit count is 3 scheduled restocking visits each week: a format restocked exactly 3 times each week is at or above it, and a format restocked twice each week is below it.

| Approved resumption requests over the twelve months | Scheduled restocking visits each week | Step credited |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 3 or more | 2 per cent of the settlement |
| 2 or more | 2 or fewer | 4 per cent of the settlement |
| 1 or none | any | none |

*Hypothetical.* An agreement on a format restocked 5 times each week, carrying 3 approved resumption requests over the trailing year, with a settlement of 6000.00 USD, is credited a further 120.00 USD. On a format restocked twice each week the same agreement would be credited 240.00 USD.
